recommendation: Keep this narrow source correction. It completes the published clarification by removing the stale gathered-answers summary label while preserving the approved detailed definition and avoiding broader, unsupported changes to comments, examples, or generated-looking SVG output.
issue_request: FHIR-32380 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to remove ambiguity in QuestionnaireResponse.authored, whose displayed text said the date answers were gathered even though forms can be completed, amended, or kept in draft over time. The approved wording defines authored as the date and/or time the questionnaire response was last modified by the user, including changed answers or revised status.
initial_application: Commit 01e7a471995499204e279fdb1e766be80f87057f explicitly applied FHIR-32380 by changing the formal QuestionnaireResponse.authored definition to the approved last-modified wording, and 0f20be07a1bc803c34b6ba4c8ac71be95a9b88a2 added the final period. Those commits left the active element short label as "Date the answers were gathered", so the ambiguity still appeared in summary/generated conformance surfaces.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml is the authoritative current StructureDefinition source. The Event mapping exception file mirrors the resource-specific short/definition divergence for QuestionnaireResponse.authored and needed to stay aligned. Confluence SDC minutes record the 2021-06-03 vote as Persuasive with Modification; quoted Zulip and Confluence full-text searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml and source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-event-mapping-exceptions.xml from "Date the answers were gathered" to "Date the questionnaire response was last modified". The approved detailed definition already matched Jira and was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml: changed QuestionnaireResponse.authored short label to "Date the questionnaire response was last modified".
source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: changed the QuestionnaireResponse.authored resource short mirror to the same corrected label.
